author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

Adds an option to `TrackToTrackComparisonHists` to match HLT and offline tracks by shared hit DetIds instead of by R (`matchByHits`, `minSharedHitFraction`). The matching is done by a new header-only `TrackAssociatorByDetId` that does both directions in a single pass. The new monitors `hltMerged2highPurity{,PV}ByHits` and their harvesting are added to the HLT-vs-offline tracking DQM.

It also fixes two existing bugs in the matched-pair histograms: the HLT and offline tracks were swapped, and  was not wrapped into [-, ]. As a result, in existing folders `matches_d*` change sign and `matches_*_vs_*` swap axes. Efficiencies and fake rates are unchanged.

Hit matching needs TrackExtras and rechits, so it works on RECO but not AOD.

#### PR validation:

The associator was unit-tested on its own against a mock `reco::Track`.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport, no backport foreseen.
title: Support track association by common `DetId` list in `TrackToTrackComparisonHists`
